description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CGI is hiring an entry-level Software Developer to build technology solutions that address client needs. The role works with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance software, while using modern and AI-enabled development practices.
Entry-Level Software Developer designing, building, and maintaining applications, supporting integrations, and testing secure, reliable solutions

Responsibilities:
• Develop a strong understanding of your client’s industry, organization, customers, business objective and technology needs
• Build trusted relationships with clients and teammates by asking thoughtful questions, actively listening, and clarifying business and technical needs
• Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical software solutions
• Design, develop and maintain software features and applications using programming languages, frameworks, and development tools based on project needs
• Work collaboratively throughout the software development lifecycle to design, code, test, debug and enhance reliable technology solutions
• Support application integrations, data connections, databases, and other technical components based on solution and project needs
• Troubleshoot issues, test functionality, and contribute to code reviews and continuous improvements that support quality, security, performance, and maintainability
• Use modern and AI‑enabled development tools to support coding, research, documentation, testing, debugging, and solution development
• Apply responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight by reviewing and validating AI-assisted outputs for accuracy, security, quality and alignment with development standards
• Document code, designs, and processes and collaborate with cross-functional team members throughout the project lifecycle to support successful solution delivery and ongoing improvement

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
• Authorization to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future employer sponsorship
• Curiosity, professionalism, and a strong desire for continuous learning
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with comfort navigating ambiguity and complex information
• Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify and explain complex ideas
• Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with fast-paced cross functional teams
• Foundational proficiency in full-stack development in at least two programming languages (one frontend and backend)
• Foundational understanding of data/AI engineering and analysis concepts and technologies, such as object-oriented programming, databases/SQL, business intelligence, artificial intelligence and machine learning, APIs, testing version control and the software development lifecycle
• Understanding of Enterprise Resource Planning and Customer Relationship Management tools
• Hands on software development experience through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects
• Interest in learning and responsibly using AI-enabled development tools, cloud technologies, frameworks and other emerging technologies based on project needs

Preferred:
• Exposure to the public sector (i.e., State, Local, and/or Higher Education) and/or energy sectors is preferred but not required
